items.title: Existence of a nonzero c with A/cA reduced and a dividing a power of c in a two-dimensional normal local domain
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 10 行、二维正规局部域中 c 的存在性：把 div(a) 写成 n_i p_i（radical-element 引理证明的记号），取 c ∈ p_1∩…∩p_r 且 A/cA 既约（radical-element 引理）；n ≥ max(n_i) 时 -div(a)+div(c^n) 有效，于是 c^n/a 属于每个高一度素点处的局部化，由正规域的局部化交判据（代数章 031T）得 c^n/a ∈ A，即 a 整除 c^n。承重全在 span 内；2 处引用（1 同章、1 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-divides-radical (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 38238-38244

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the expression of the divisor of a in terms of the height-one primes of the proof of the radical-element lemma, the choice of c in the intersection of those primes with A/cA reduced, the effectivity of the divisor -div(a) + div(c^n) for n at least the multiplicities, and the containment c^n/a in A by the normal-domain intersection-of-localizations criterion (source lines 38246-38255)
